description: This Rust source file implements the `+watch` command for Gmail push notifications via Pub/Sub, including setup of Pub/Sub topics/subscriptions, Gmail watch configuration, message polling, and optional sanitization.

classes.name: WatchConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the Gmail watch process, including project info, subscription, topic, label IDs, message limits, polling interval, output format, and cleanup options.

methods.name: handle_watch
methods.description: Main function to handle the `+watch` command, setting up Pub/Sub resources, initiating Gmail watch, and managing message polling and cleanup.

methods.name: watch_pull_loop
methods.description: Asynchronous loop that polls Pub/Sub for messages, processes notifications, fetches email history, and outputs messages, with support for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: process_pull_response
methods.description: Processes Pub/Sub pull response, extracting acknowledgment IDs and the maximum history ID from messages.

methods.name: fetch_and_output_messages
methods.description: Fetches email messages since the last known history ID and outputs them as JSON, applying sanitization if configured.

methods.name: apply_sanitization_result
methods.description: Applies sanitization results to messages, blocking or warning based on configuration, and adding metadata if needed.

methods.name: extract_message_ids_from_history
methods.description: Extracts message IDs from Gmail history API responses.

methods.name: parse_watch_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a WatchConfig struct, validating output directory and setting defaults.
